rationale:
The change corrects an artifact-recording path collision and adds one held same-run continuation; I verified it independently against the in-scope source and evidence.

Correctness: The defect was that generated artifacts were written to current/<name>, colliding with same-named immutable predecessor outputs carried in copied seed context, causing OUTPUT_VALIDATION_REFUSED: IMMUTABLE_ARTIFACT_CONFLICT after the author had already completed and been charged. The fix (manual_driver.py:265) namespaces new writes under current/runs/<sha256(run_id)>/<name>, hashing the run_id rather than interpreting it as a path. Artifact rows store the relative path; every consumer I inspected (base UPDATE_STATE at manual_driver.py:555-557, analysis COMMIT_SPEC/UPDATE_STATE at analysis_driver.py:425/459, and the adapted test_manual_lane.py:256-257) selects content through artifact['path']/basename, so selection keys and hash binding stay consistent. Immutability is still enforced by write_once; the test confirms same-run same-name identical writes reuse the path, differing bytes refuse, and a distinct run_id yields a distinct path.

Continuation module: prior() binds the exact frozen checkpoint (config, source, run_id, item 5, preparation plan, owner, context inventory, local manual_* rows, pending run_spec_author/round1, saved SPEC.proposed.md output, global call row, global owner, and absence of RUNNING calls). prepare() requires exact APPROVE verifier binding to HEAD and report hash, held install with runtime match, all units inactive, no prior continuation event and no HALT; it copies non-ledger files, performs a real SQLite backup as owner, writes one events row, re-verifies prior() and the copied rows, and resets no allowance (allowance_reset False, calls_used 1, call_limit 16). accept_saved_author routes the preserved BLOCKED/IMMUTABLE_ARTIFACT_CONFLICT state through accept_completed with no model runner, reusing the workspace output and re-checking receipt hashes, ending at run_spec_review. completed_predecessors releases only the exact proved predecessor after an authenticated COMPLETE successor whose preserved call rows are byte-identical, returning [] for unknown/incomplete/unproved state, and preserves the historical BLOCKED record. The completed=True owner-status normalization is narrowly limited to a COMPLETE->ACTIVE status rewrite and cannot mask other field changes.
